D: A nervous student with a list of survival rules crosses a zombie-filled America with a Twinkie-hunting tough guy and two con artist sisters.
P: Serve the club sandwiches when the gang pulls up at Bill Murray's house.
S: Enjoy the little things mini corn dogs
Mini corn dogs on sticks. Rule 32 is enjoy the little things.

Pat the franks dry and push a skewer into each. Whisk the cornmeal, flour, sugar, salt, egg and milk into a thick batter and pour it into a tall glass. Dip each frank in the batter and fry in oil at 180C, turning, until deep golden. Drain and serve with mustard and tomato sauce.
Potato skins loaded with cheese and bacon, twice. Rule 2 is the double tap.

Rub the potatoes with oil and salt and bake at 200C until tender. Fry the bacon until crisp. Halve the potatoes, scoop out most of the flesh and save it for mash. Fill the skins with bacon and cheddar and bake again until crisp and melted. Top with sour cream and spring onion.
M: Double cheeseburgers with burger sauce. It all started with mad cow disease.

Roll the mince into 8 balls and stir the mayonnaise, tomato sauce and mustard together. Heat a heavy pan until smoking, add a ball with some onion on top and smash it flat with a spatula. Cook until the edges crisp, flip, add cheese and stack two patties per burger. Toast the buns, spread with sauce and build with the patties and pickles.
Club sandwiches with fries. Bill Murray's one regret: Garfield, maybe.

Bake the fries at 220C until crisp. Fry the bacon until crisp. Toast the bread and spread each slice with mayonnaise. Layer turkey, lettuce, bacon and tomato over three slices per sandwich. Pin with toothpicks, cut into triangles and serve with the fries.
W: Deep-fried Twinkies with vanilla ice cream
Battered Twinkies fried golden with vanilla ice cream. Ya spongy yellow delicious bastards.

Whisk the flour, egg and milk into a smooth batter. Skewer the frozen Twinkies and dip them in the batter. Fry at 180C for 2 to 3 minutes until golden, then drain. Dust with icing sugar and serve with ice cream.
K: Nut up or shut up peanut butter shakes
Time to nut up or shut up
Blend the banana, peanut butter, ice cream and milk until thick. Swirl chocolate topping round 4 glasses and pour in the shakes.
